label: LTX 2.5 I2V HDR
description: LTX-2.5 Native HDR image to video: a new HDR clip from one HDR still and an optional prompt. Output: an EXR sequence in ACES2065-1 at its own size, numbered from the chosen frame, no audio.
usage: Makes a new HDR clip from one frame of the input (LTX-2.5 Native HDR, two stages).
The input must already be real HDR, as it isn't upgraded from SDR. For an SDR plate use LTX SDR to HDR.
'Set to current frame' picks the frame. The output starts at that frame.
prompt is optional and describes the motion. 'long edge' is the final size, with the input's aspect.
'image strength' 1.0 locks the first frame to the still. Keep 'refine prompt' off when matching a plate.

License (checked 2026-11): LTX-2.x Community - commercial use is free under $10M annual revenue (affiliates count); above that needs a paid license. Generated content must be disclosed as machine-generated when distributed.

output.tooltip: LTX makes a new clip at its own size, not the plate's.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: Optional: the motion and what happens in the clip. Your still supplies the scene.

knobs.name: frames
knobs.label: frames
knobs.tooltip: Clip length, rounded down to the 8n+1 count the model needs (9, 17, ... 121). It plays at the script's fps. More frames need more VRAM and time.

knobs.name: long_edge
knobs.label: long edge
knobs.tooltip: Long edge of the final output, with the input's aspect. Stage 1 renders at half this and stage 2 doubles it; stage 1 snaps to a multiple of 32, so a 16:9 input at 1920 gives 1920x1088.

knobs.name: refine_prompt
knobs.label: refine prompt
knobs.tooltip: Let the local Gemma enhancer (sees the still) rewrite the prompt first. Slower. Lightricks recommends off when matching a plate.

knobs.name: image_strength
knobs.label: image strength
knobs.tooltip: How firmly the first frame follows your still, in both stages. 1.0 = locked.

knobs.name: cfg
knobs.label: cfg
knobs.tooltip: Both stages. The workflow advises staying close to 1.
